craft_notes: Sthāyin: word-becomes-Śiva (fear resounding all → constant uttering → Śiva: fear transmuted to formula to god). Rows: row 3 (uttering→Śiva). Close: Śiva (the name closes the song — first Śiva-word since v121's then). Rejected: 'mantra' — killed: Bhairava-word kept (the word OF him, possessive); 'fearlessness' — killed: fear-resounds kept (bhaya stays IN the verse: transmuted, never removed).

lines: Fear resounds all, giving-all pervasive wholeness:
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhayā sarvaṃ ravayati sarvado vyāpako 'khile | iti bhairavaśabdasya santatoccāraṇāc chivaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does Śiva come from the word? → Constant uttering of the Bhairava-word makes Śiva from all resounding.
c1_essence: Fear resounds all in wholeness: Bhairava's word, Śiva.
